$comment: Audio pipeline config (docs/FX_AUDIO.md A0 / A1; scripts/audio/build-audio.js). Paths are relative to art/vendor/. Each sound ID: category (sfx | jingle | music | ambience), clips (several = variants, played round-robin; a clip is a path or { src, gainDb?, trim?: [startSec, endSec?], mix?: [paths layered on src], lowpassHz? }), volume (0..1, the SoundAsset volume), pitch ([min, max] PlaybackSpeed jitter), minInterval (seconds, overrides the code's default), gainDb (on top of the category's normalisation), confirmed (false until the owner picked it by ear), alternates (listed on the audition page), notes. "silent": true leaves the ID silent. After editing: npm run audio:lock, npm run audio:build, npm run audio:audition.

output.$comment: Vorbis at a fixed quality. Lossy encoding overshoots transients: a decoded sample peak above maxDecodedPeakDb is re-encoded with the gain lowered by the overshoot plus peakStepDb (at most peakPasses encodes).

limits.$comment: Roblox audio upload limits: under 20 MB, under 7 minutes, 48 kHz or lower.

silence.$comment: Silence trim (sfx and jingles): threshold, and how much silence to keep before the onset and after the end.

sfx.player.shoot.notes: Bow volley; 0.06 s minimum interval in code. Launch is quiet raw (-22 dBFS peak); the build peak-normalises it.

sfx.player.swing.notes: Sword combo swings 1 and 2 (the finisher plays sfx.player.finisher).

sfx.player.hurt.notes: Must cut through everything: the loudest sound effect.

sfx.player.deflect.notes: Guard deletes bullets; 0.08 s minimum interval in code.

sfx.ember.notes: Bullet clear: rare and big, ducks the music. Magic3 is 2.7 s; check it is not too long.

sfx.enemy.shoot.notes: Bullet-hell density: quiet, 0.08 s interval in code.

sfx.enemy.telegraph.notes: A warning: must be distinct from every hit sound.

sfx.boss.roar.notes: Gap: no real roar in the pack. Strange.wav is 3.3 s but silent after 0.8 s: the build's silence trim keeps the 0.8 s.

sfx.boss.taunt.notes: The Demon Lord's phase-change laugh (docs/BOSS_DEMONLORD.md D6; the roar plays while this is silent). D7: audition a laugh from ninja-adventure/Audio/Voice/ (not in the D6 sandbox) and set clips.

sfx.breakable.hit.notes: Gap: no wood sounds in the pack.

sfx.breakable.break.notes: Gap: no wood sounds in the pack.

sfx.loot.drop.notes: No caller yet (no loot lands in this build): silent so it costs no upload. Pick from the alternates when loot lands.

sfx.loot.rare.notes: No caller yet: silent, like sfx.loot.drop.

sfx.ui.confirm.notes: Not Menu/Accept.wav: that one is 2 s long.

sfx.ui.move.notes: Gamepad focus moves: very quiet, rate-limited in code (SFX_MIN_INTERVAL).

sfx.player.finisher.notes: The sword's 3rd swing: Sword2 layered over Slash4 (the plan's 'Sword2 + Slash4').

sfx.player.charged.notes: Bow charge reaches full (the local player's only).

sfx.room.perfect.notes: docs/ROOM_CLEAR.md: PERFECT's stamp lands. Ducks the music.

sfx.score.tick.notes: docs/ROOM_CLEAR.md: a tally segment starts counting.

sfx.pellet.eat.notes: docs/PELLETS.md PL7: a pellet eaten. "Chomp" by Barnaby (cryptologymedia, Pixabay, id 155392), the owner's pick: 0.99 s, 44.1 kHz mono MP3: quiet to 0.12 s, a soft lead-in, two bites (peaks about 0.24 s and 0.40 s, the dip between them at 0.38 s), silent from 0.60 s. The [0.12, 0.38] trim keeps the first bite only, so a line of pellets reads one bite each. One clip, pitched by the cue mapper's room ladder (pelletEatSpeed: the major scale, root to octave), so no pitch jitter here; the 0.06 s minimum interval matches PELLETS_VIEW.audio.

sfx.pellet.sweep.notes: docs/PELLETS.md PL7: a room swept (every regular pellet taken before the clear; plays with the room clear). "Swish swoosh woosh SFX 27" by Stereogenic Studio (Pixabay, id 357164), the owner's pick: 5.33 s, 48 kHz stereo MP3: the swoosh 0.15 - 0.9 s (peak about 0.52 s), a reverb tail fading under -40 dB from 1.0 s; the [0, 1.2] trim keeps the swoosh and the start of its tail (the silence trim takes the lead). No pitch jitter.

sfx.score.land.notes: docs/ROOM_CLEAR.md: the room bonus lands in the score panel.

sfx.depth.up.notes: A boss kill grows the Depth. Ducks the music.

sfx.jingle.gameover.notes: Run over (every player dead), over the music fading out; then silence (X7).

sfx.combo.tier.notes: Combo tier-up sting (docs/COMBO.md CD7): one clip, pitched by the cue mapper per tier (0 / +3 / +5 / +7 semitones at x2 / x3 / x4 / x5), so no pitch jitter here. Not a jingle: it may play with the room clear. Pick Bonus2 or Bonus3 at the audition (CD12).

sfx.combo.break.notes: Combo break during a fight (docs/COMBO.md CD12): "Glass breaking" by DRAGON-STUDIO (Pixabay, id 504033). 3.12 s, 48 kHz stereo MP3: 85 ms lead (the silence trim takes it), the crash 0.1 - 1.0 s, a stray tinkle at 1.9 - 2.05 s that the [0, 1.2] trim cuts, silence after. A small break (below x2) plays it at half volume (COMBO_VIEW.smallBreakVolume). No pitch jitter.

sfx.player.graze.notes: A graze's airy shimmer (docs/GRAZE_PARRY.md GPD4): audition candidates (GP0), not picked yet. One clip, pitched by the cue mapper's chain ladder (+1 semitone per chained graze, cap +7), so no pitch jitter here. The 0.05 s minimum interval lives in code.

sfx.player.parry.notes: A parry's bright ring-out, once per guard that erased bullets (docs/GRAZE_PARRY.md GPD10): audition candidates (GP0), not picked yet. Replaces that frame's sfx.player.deflect (the fallback while this is silent); +3 semitones from 3 erases, so no pitch jitter here. The minimum interval lives in code.

sfx.draft.flip.notes: docs/DRAFT_REVEAL.md DRD11: a draft card flips (a light card snap; the two clips are variants). Played by the reveal controller at the flip ladder's pitch (+0 / +2 / +4 semitones per card), so no pitch jitter here; 0.05 s minimum interval in code. Pick at the audition.

sfx.draft.rare.notes: docs/DRAFT_REVEAL.md DRD11: a rare face lands (the chime, with the trim flare and the shine). Pick Magic5 or Heal3 at the audition.

sfx.draft.charge.notes: docs/DRAFT_REVEAL.md DRD11: a legendary card's charge, one short hit played six times as a rising ladder (closing in from 0.16 s to 0.07 s apart, +0 -> +12 semitones, the reveal's per-cue speed; no riser clip), so it must be short (well under 0.07 s of attack) and has no pitch jitter; 0.05 s minimum interval in code (under the ladder's closest gap). Pick Move7, Menu5 or Alert4 at the audition.

sfx.draft.legendary.notes: docs/DRAFT_REVEAL.md DRD11: the legendary flare's sting (the flash, the ray burst, the pop). A jingle: it ducks the music for its length (DUCKING_SFX), on top of the charge's music dip. Pick Secret3 or Secret4 at the audition.

sfx.draft.pick.notes: docs/DRAFT_REVEAL.md DRD10 / DRD11: a boon is taken (the stamp). Pick Accept2, Accept3 or Accept5 at the audition.

sfx.enemy.blink.notes: docs/ENEMY_VARIANTS.md EV11: an Imp snaps to its ring (the landing tick). Whoosh2 is a short air cut (0.44 s, audible 0.26 s, peak at 0.14 s), unused as a pick elsewhere (sfx.player.roll's alternate). Alternates: Magic1 (a bright 0.4 s zap, more magical; sfx.enemy.shoot's alternate), Wings (a 0.45 s flutter, imp-like). Imps come in pairs: pitch jitter and a 0.15 s interval keep two blinks from phasing.

sfx.enemy.summon.notes: docs/ENEMY_VARIANTS.md EV11: a Summoner calls its two swarmers. Spirit is a high ghostly swell (1.5 s, audible 1.4 s, peak at 0.24 s), unused as a pick (sfx.boss.roar's and sfx.shrine.use's alternate): started with the 1.0 s summon ring it fills the telegraph. Alternates: Alert5 (a 1.5 s warning swell, more alarm than magic), Magic2 (0.31 s, for a cue on the burst itself rather than the telegraph). At most one Summoner per room, so no pitch jitter.

sfx.enemy.split.notes: docs/ENEMY_VARIANTS.md EV11: an Ooze dies and splits into two slimelets. Bubble2 is a 0.43 s wet bubble pop (not Bubble.wav, sfx.player.graze's 1.5 s alternate). It plays over the kill's sfx.enemy.death, so it stays quieter. Alternates: Water4 (0.41 s splash, sharper onset), Water9 (0.54 s, a slower slosh). Pitch jitter: a guard sweep can kill two at once.

sfx.enemy.fuse.notes: docs/NEW_ENEMIES.md NE10: a Bomber lights its fuse (the 0.7 s fuse ring). Fire is a short flare and crackle (0.89 s, audible 0.81 s, peak at 0.11 s), unused as a pick (amb.b2's alternate): it burns through the fuse and the blast covers its tail. Alternates: Fire3 (0.65 s, sfx.affix.vengeful's pick), Fireball2 (0.49 s whoosh-flare, unused). Bombers come in groups: pitch jitter.

sfx.enemy.blast.notes: docs/NEW_ENEMIES.md NE10: a Bomber detonates (the ring of bullets). Explosion5 is the one Explosion unused anywhere (0.79 s, audible 0.68 s, immediate onset): a full boom, longer than sfx.affix.shieldbreak's Explosion3 crunch and shorter than sfx.boss.death's Explosion6. Alternates: Explosion2 (0.63 s, sfx.breakable.break's alternate), Explosion4 (0.73 s, sfx.boss.death's alternate). It plays over the kill's sfx.enemy.death.

sfx.enemy.charge.notes: docs/NEW_ENEMIES.md NE10: a Charger launches down its lane. Whoosh is a short air rush (0.33 s, audible 0.22 s, peak at 0.10 s), unused as a pick (sfx.player.shoot's alternate); pitched a little down for the beast's weight. Alternates: Slash5, Whoosh2 (sfx.enemy.blink's pick: avoid, an Imp can share the room).

sfx.enemy.stun.notes: docs/NEW_ENEMIES.md NE10: a Charger slams into a wall and is stunned. Hit5 is a 0.33 s punch (peak at 0.11 s), the one Hit & Impact clip unused as a pick (sfx.player.hurt's and sfx.affix.shieldbreak's alternate); pitched down to a heavier thud so it does not read as the player being hit (check at the audition). Alternates: Impact4 (sfx.enemy.death's and sfx.breakable.hit's), Impact5 (sfx.player.death's and sfx.breakable.break's).

sfx.enemy.strike.notes: docs/NEW_ENEMIES.md NE10: a Stormcaller's lightning strike lands (one cue per tick for the row's three strikes, minInterval 0.12 s as the cue row). "Lightning strike" by DRAGON-STUDIO (Pixabay, id 386161), the owner's pick: 1.10 s, 44.1 kHz stereo MP3: 113 ms lead (the silence trim takes it), the crack 0.11 - 0.3 s, the rumble fading to silence by 0.98 s; used whole. No pitch jitter. The Explosion alternates were the stand-ins while it was silent.

sfx.enemy.spin.notes: docs/NEW_ENEMIES.md NE10: a Reaper starts its spin (the 1.6 s spiral). Whoosh2 is a short air cut (0.44 s, audible 0.25 s), also sfx.enemy.blink's pick: pitched well down (0.8-0.88 against the blink's 0.95-1.08) so the sickles' sweep reads lower and heavier. Alternates: Slash4, Whoosh (sfx.enemy.charge's pick).

sfx.affix.shieldbreak.notes: docs/ENEMY_VARIANTS.md EV11: a Shielded enemy's shield breaks (the plan's sfx.affix.shieldBreak). Explosion3 is a short bright crunch (0.33 s, immediate onset, the brightest of the short explosions), sfx.enemy.death's alternate, unused as a pick. Alternates: Hit5 (0.33 s punch, sfx.player.hurt's alternate: check it does not read as the player being hit), Explosion (0.37 s, duller). Must stand apart from sfx.enemy.hurt (Hit*) and sfx.combo.break (the glass).

sfx.affix.vengeful.notes: docs/ENEMY_VARIANTS.md EV11: a Vengeful corpse's ring. Fire3 is a 0.65 s flare (audible 0.6 s), about the corpse's 0.6 s telegraph, so started with the pulse it ends as the ring fires. Alternates: Alert4 (0.42 s, a warning, if the cue should read as a telegraph like sfx.enemy.telegraph), Explosion2 (0.63 s burst, if the cue plays on the ring itself).

sfx.best.new.notes: docs/NEW_BEST.md NBD6: the in-run new-best fanfare (~1.2 s): the shown score passes the best, or the first floor past the deepest at the stairwell card's reveal (in place of sfx.floor.enter). A jingle: it ducks the music and outranks the room clear's jingles on a shared frame (NBD7). Must read apart from room clear's Success1 and PERFECT's Success2. Audition LevelUp2 / LevelUp3 / Success4 (NB10); while silent the PERFECT jingle plays.

sfx.jingle.record.notes: docs/NEW_BEST.md NBD6: a record run's run over (2-3 s), in place of sfx.jingle.gameover (a death on a record run sounds like a win). LevelUp3 layered with Success4 (mix); tune the layer's gainDb / trim at the audition (NB10). GameOver2 is wrong in tone. While silent the game-over jingle plays.

sfx.rank.up.notes: docs/DAILY.md DS10: a daily run's predicted rank enters the top 100 / 10 / 3 / #1, with the TOP 10! floor shout. A short sting, not a jingle (no duck); the new-best fanfare wins a shared frame. Must read apart from the combo tier's Bonus2 and relic's PowerUp2. Unused as a primary clip so far (sfx.loot.rare's alternate only). Audition at DS12.

sfx.friend.passed.notes: docs/DAILY.md DS10: a friend passed on today's daily board, with their headshot toast (one per toast, the toasts queue). Short and light, under sfx.rank.up. Unused as a primary clip so far (relic's alternate only). Audition at DS12.

music.biome.2.notes: molten. Dark Castle is 33 s: check it does not get repetitive.

music.boss.notes: The pack's file name has two spaces before the dash.

music.tutorial.notes: The tutorial played the biome.1 track before this ID existed (it still does while this ID is silent).

music.lobby.notes: Silent: the lobby room plays music.menu (the fallback). Give it a track only if the lobby should not share the menu's.

amb.b2.notes: molten. Gap: no fire-crackle bed in the pack (Elemental/Fire* are one-shots, not loops). Silent until another CC0 source is found.

amb.b3.notes: frost. Wind.wav starts with 0.92 s and ends with 0.73 s of silence: trimmed so the loop has no gap (check the seam).
